from pathlib import Path
root = Path(r'C:\Users\stop-\n1-kanji-workspace')

pins = {
 'N1-B126-CLAUDE-001-acceptance.json': 'cab7357d0bf6f26daa800304e06758e609289fc03216a70ae0214858ce524061',
 'N1-B126-CLAUDE-001-adjudication.json': 'bcada2db6d586058506db59bd0b1d2e3bcf918ca0144e3bfb5e99be39b7a0c68',
 'N1-B126-GPT-001-launch.json': 'c9da79d0495848240f23dcc424d46872bfffa23ce4d9128e4aa2ebc01596816f',
 'N1-B126-GPT-001-phase2-message.txt': '6c65d9e7fbea2a299efac7f7274fffdc832e3a7dda86a3f6a85ce3c2e09d40a0',

}
checked = {}
def check(path, digest):
 actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 assert actual == digest, (str(path), actual)
 assert not path.stat().st_mode & stat.S_IWRITE, str(path)
 checked[str(path)] = actual
for name, digest in pins.items(): check(review / name, digest)
a = json.loads((review / 'N1-B126-CLAUDE-001-acceptance.json').read_text('utf-8'))
assert a['reviewAccepted'] and a['verdict'] == 'CLEAN' and a['acceptedFindings'] == []
assert a['candidate'] == '246a1319ef30414d73e4518b52ae99c1d700c57e'
for key in ('report', 'final', 'adjudication'):
 check(Path(a[key]['path']), a[key]['sha256'])
f = json.loads(Path(a['final']['path']).read_text('utf-8'))
assert f['status'] == 'MECHANICAL_PASS_REQUIRES_SUBSTANTIVE_ADJUDICATION' and not f['problems']
for key in ('finalAudit', 'context', 'structure', 'evidenceCheck'):
 check(Path(f[key]['path']), f[key]['sha256'])
p = json.loads((review / 'N1-B126-GPT-001-phase1.json').read_text('utf-8'))
assert p['status'] == 'PHASE1_READY' and p['readyForPhase2'] and not p['breaches']
assert p['session'] == '655acc5f-64c3-4842-813e-7be830558e3e'
assert p['actualResponseModels'] == ['gpt-6.1-sol'] and p['context']['status'] == 'PASS'
for name, key in [('audit.json','auditSha256'),('events.jsonl','eventsSha256'),('phase1-list.txt','phase1ListSha256')]:
 check(Path(p['auditDir']) / name, p[key])
repo = root / 'b126-worktree'
head = subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-pager','-C',str(repo),'rev-parse','HEAD'], text=True, timeout=30).strip()
assert head == a['candidate']
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-pager','-C',str(repo),'status','--porcelain=v1'], text=True, timeout=30).strip()
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','candidate':head,'worktreeClean':True,'checked':checked,'limit':'Recovery identity validation; GPT final verdict and substantive reconciliation remain pending.'}, indent=2))
